selector-class-pattern.message: Class names are BEM in kebab-case: block, block__element, block--modifier (e.g. .pattern-graph__node--active)

custom-property-pattern.message: Custom property names are kebab-case with camelCase segments allowed, optionally prefixed with _ when local to one component (e.g. --c-bodyDimmed, --_crumb-padding)

selector-class-pattern.message: These files style tldraw and ProseMirror, whose class names this project does not own; project-owned classes here are still BEM in kebab-case

keyframes-name-pattern.message: Keyframe names are kebab-case, or follow the vendor class they animate
